//: Used by `npm run build` / `npm run dev` only. tsconfig.json includes
tests/ so `tsc --noEmit` (typecheck) and ts-jest enforce strict on the
test suite too, but the shipped dist/ must not contain compiled test
output — this config extends the base and excludes tests/ for that.
declaration:true emits .d.ts files alongside dist/**/*.js — additive
only, no change to the emitted JS or runtime behavior. Needed so
desktop/ipc/*.ts (the IPC migration) gets real types when it imports
without it TS falls back to inferring types from bare JS parameter
defaults, which silently produces wrong types (e.g. a `message: string`
parameter whose default is `ReasonPhrases.OK` infers as the enum type
ReasonPhrases, not string, once the original annotation is stripped).
